slots.label: Grab Text
slots.caption: From screen
slots.about: Copies the text in any area you drag over, even inside images and videos.

slots.label: Screenshot
slots.caption: To clipboard
slots.about: Copies a picture of any area you drag over, ready to paste.

slots.label: Scan QR
slots.caption: From screen
slots.about: Reads a QR code or barcode you drag over. Links open, anything else is copied.

slots.label: Pick Color
slots.caption: As hex
slots.about: Copies the color of any pixel on screen as a hex value.

slots.label: Switch Theme
slots.caption: Light or dark
slots.about: Switches your Mac between light and dark mode.

slots.label: Play or Pause
slots.caption: Any player
slots.about: Plays or pauses whatever is playing, like pressing the media key.

slots.label: Toggle Mic
slots.caption: Mute or unmute
slots.about: Mutes your microphone. Pick again to unmute.

slots.label: Start Timer
slots.caption: 25 minutes
slots.about: Starts a 25-minute timer that ends with a notification. Pick again to cancel.
